body.message:
Hello!
We are looking for short-term rental options with the following requirements:
* Quantity: 2 apartments
* Rental period: April 10 – May 10 (1 month)
* Location: Downtown Dubai
* Type: 1–2 bedrooms
Apartment requirements:
* new, high-quality renovation
* panoramic windows
* fully furnished and ready to move in (furniture, appliances)
Additional preferences:
* Ideally, both apartments should be in the same building
* If not available, we are open to options in nearby buildings within walking distance
Please share available options with photos and your best possible price.
Thank you!
